invariants.rationale: The method requires a node parameter; it is likely intended to be non-null.
At entry, node.parent could be either null or not null; both are possible, so either state is admissible.
The method assumes node.actor is non-null because it calls node.actor.getZIndex() unconditionally if node reaches that point.
A node likely cannot be its own parent in a tree structure.
It is unlikely in a scene tree that a node refers directly to the Tree instance itself.
